titulo_ja: と したら と とすれば

bloques.titulo: In the case of the United States, the Commission has also taken the view that it is not possible to consider the possible consequences of the case.
texto: They do not claim that the condition is real.
The budget should be halved and the priorities of the plan should be changed.
(If we assume that all will participate, another room will have to be prepared.)

frases.ja: 予算 が 半分 に なる と したら、計画 の 優先順位 を 変える 必要 が あります。
frases.es: Si el presupuesto se redujera a la mitad, habría que cambiar las prioridades del plan.
frases.en: If the budget were to be halved, the priorities of the plan would have to be changed.

frases.ja: 全員 が 参加 する と すれば、会場 を もう一つ 用意 しなければ なりません。
frases.es: Si suponemos que todos participarán, habrá que preparar otra sala.
frases.en: If we assume that everyone will be involved, we will have to prepare another room.
